intro: Rockstar revealed the first six GTA 6 radio stations on 8 October 2026 and says this is the widest mix of radio and podcasts in any GTA, covering everything from classic rock to talk radio. So more stations are coming; these are the six with names and hosts so far.

sources.title: All Things How – every confirmed GTA 6 station and host
GTA Intel – GTA 6 radio stations revealed (Rockstar Newswire, 8 Oct 2026)
Alviran – station list and The Album

stations.name: Flash FM
stations.note: The returning pop station from GTA Vice City.

stations.name: The Chamber 106.6
stations.note: Hosted by two members of Slayer.

howItWorks: Radio keeps playing when you get out of a vehicle. Jason and Lucia's phones pair with headphones or earbuds, a first for the series.
Both leads can also play podcasts on demand.
The old radio wheel is replaced by a sliding station menu with an On-Demand option.
Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album was announced on 17 September 2026. Digital, vinyl and CD versions go on sale on 19 November 2026, launch day.
